name: Price Report Function 1 Code
definition: Specifies the function of the price report.

REPL.name: Complete Replacement Price Report
REPL.definition: The price report conveys the correction of the complete set of prices previously sent for the same price report identification.

NEWP.name: New Price Report
NEWP.definition: The price report is ‘new’, that is the report is not being used as a correction of previously sent prices.

PART.name: Partial Correction Price Report
PART.definition: The price report conveys the correction of some of the prices previously sent for the same price report identification.
